Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

On 1 March 2027 a company that is neither the original manufacturer nor a non-professional user carries out a substantial modification of a machine placed on the market in February 2027. In what capacity (as which economic operator) does it answer for that machine under the act applicable on that day?

response.text: On 1 March 2027, a company that is neither the original manufacturer nor a non-professional user performs a substantial modification to a machine that was placed on the market in February 2027. Under the act in force on that date, as which economic operator is it answerable for the machine?
